claims: Cruzeiro secured a 1-0 away victory against Barcelona SC in their opening match of the 2026 CONMEBOL Libertadores Group Stage.
The match was held on April 7, 2026.
The match was held at the Monumental Stadium in Guayaquil.
Matheus Pereira scored the winning goal for Cruzeiro in the second half.
Matheus Pereira (Cruzeiro) was the goalscorer in the 2nd half.
The competition was CONMEBOL Libertadores - Group D, Round 1.
Estadio Monumental Banco Pichincha, Guayaquil, Ecuador.
Matheus Pereira broke the deadlock within 10 minutes of the second half restart.
Matheus Pereira headed in the goal from a right-wing cross.
Barcelona SC (5-3-2): José Contreras; Álex Rangel, Javier Báez, Luca Sosa, Bryan Carabalí, Gustavo Vallecilla; Milton Céliz, Matías Lugo, Jhonny Quiñónez; Luis Cano, Darío Benedetto.
Cruzeiro (4-2-3-1): Matheus Cunha; Fágner, Fabrício Bruno, Jonathan Jesus, Kaiki; Gérson, Lucas Silva; Keny Arroyo, Matheus Pereira, Christian Cardoso; Kaio Jorge.
